top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a simple, general mechanism: a Z2 invariant from time-reversal symmetry and spin-orbit coupling that forces disorder-robust edge states, predicted by Kane and Mele and observed as quantised edge transport in HgTe wells by Molenkamp's group, then reproduced independently over about twenty years. With the citation confined to the 2D quantum spin Hall effect and Z2 topological insulators, the trio is coherent, although Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and the 3D work stay a real attribution weakness. P001 is a well-credited, mature measurement achievement but overlaps the 2005 and 2012 timekeeping-related prizes and is more capability than new principle, so I rank it second; a defensible award beats no award.
